bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/compression.rs (encode_buffer, encode_buffer_threaded, decode_buffer, decode_buffer_limited, Stream, InputFilter, OutputFilter), springboard/sdk/src/compression/dynamic.rs (Level, encode, encode_threaded), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/inflate.rs (inflate, zlib), springboard/src/files/zip.rs (create, extract), springboard/src/pngenc.rs (zlib_stored)
summary: BifrOSt has DEFLATE and zlib encoding and decoding for apps through bifrost_app::compression, with a dynamic-Huffman encoder at three levels and an optional thread count for large inputs, and streams and filters that run on finalize. It has no LZFSE, LZ4, LZMA or Brotli codecs, no incremental codec state, and no compression for the Files app zip writer or the PNG writer.

features.note: DEFLATE and zlib only; takes a Level and a thread count; returns a Vec, so no scratch buffer. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 every_level_and_algorithm_round_trips, zlib_header_flevel_follows_the_level, zlib_trailer_is_the_adler32_of_the_input, one_thread_gives_the_same_bytes_as_the_single_step_call. Not yet verified on Midget.

DEFLATE and zlib only; output is capped at inflate::MAX_OUT (256 MiB) or a caller-given limit. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 zlib_reference_bytes_decode_to_hello, decode_limit_is_inclusive_and_refuses_one_byte_more, decode_reports_truncated_input. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: compression_algorithm, Algorithm (LZFSE, LZ4, LZ4_RAW, LZMA, ZLIB)
features.note: Algorithm cases exist for LZFSE, LZ4, LZBITMAP, LZMA and Brotli but fail with Unsupported; Zlib and Deflate are implemented. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 unsupported_algorithms_fail_in_every_entry_point. Not yet verified on Midget.

Input is buffered and the codec runs on the finalizing call, which returns all output; no incremental encoder or decoder state. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 compress_stream_returns_everything_on_the_finalizing_call, decompress_stream_accepts_input_in_pieces, decompress_stream_reports_bad_input_on_finalize. Not yet verified on Midget.

Input is drained on the first read; output reaches the sink in chunks of the buffer capacity. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 input_filter_serves_decoded_data_in_requested_sizes, input_filter_failure_is_sticky, input_filter_compresses_to_a_stream_that_decodes, output_filter_decodes_and_sends_chunks_of_the_capacity, output_filter_compress_output_decodes_back, output_filter_leaves_the_sink_untouched_when_the_data_is_invalid. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: compression_decode_buffer with ZLIB or raw DEFLATE
features.note: Decoder written out for the Books engine and exposed through the SDK module; no crate. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 raw_deflate_reference_bytes_decode_to_hello, decode_rejects_a_reserved_block_type, decode_reports_truncated_input. Not yet verified on Midget.

Greedy LZ77 over a 32 KiB window with dynamic Huffman blocks; Fast, Default and Best levels set the chain depth; no lazy matching or stored-block fallback. Tests: inline dynamic.rs empty_input_round_trips, short_text_round_trips_at_every_level, long_runs_and_random_bytes_round_trip; parity_sdk-tests-04 repetitive_input_compresses_and_random_input_expands_little, large_input_split_over_two_threads_is_deterministic_and_round_trips. The Files app zip writer still uses its fixed-Huffman encoder (springboard/src/files/zip.rs:331).
Writes stored (uncompressed) deflate blocks only, so PNG output is not compressed; the SDK encoder could replace it.

Decode failures and unsupported algorithms; the encode side reports only Unsupported. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 error_messages_name_the_failure, zlib_header_errors_are_invalid_data, decode_rejects_a_reserved_block_type. Not yet verified on Midget.

App-facing module for buffers, streams and filters. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 (every test in the file uses bifrost_app::compression, for example zlib_reference_bytes_decode_to_hello and compress_stream_returns_everything_on_the_finalizing_call). Not yet verified on Midget.
tied to Apple's C buffer API; Rust Vec output needs no scratch size

gaps: No LZFSE, LZ4, LZ4_RAW, LZMA or Brotli codec in either direction
No incremental stream state (init, process, destroy): streams buffer their input and run on finalize
DEFLATE encoder has no lazy matching; output is larger than zlib at the same level
PNG writer stores uncompressed zlib blocks (springboard/src/pngenc.rs:31), not deflate-compressed
Files app zip writer does not use the SDK encoder yet, so its archives are fixed-Huffman
